title: Desolation Trail
subtitle: Wasatch Mountains, Utah

## The Plan

A two-night out-and-back to the lake, with a summit day hike in the middle. Three days, easy pace, no rush.

## Day 1 — Thursday

- Eat a good breakfast before heading out
- Drive down to the trailhead
- Hike in about **6 miles to the lake**
- Set up camp and have lunch
- Enjoy the rest of the day at the lake
- Dinner at camp, then sleep

## Day 2 — Friday

- Breakfast at camp
- Leave the packs behind for a day hike up to **Silver Peak — roughly 4 miles up and 4 miles back** (all distances are estimates)
- Head back to camp for lunch
- Take it easy and enjoy the lake
- Dinner at camp, then sleep

## Day 3 — Saturday

- Breakfast at camp
- Pack up camp
- Hike back out — about **6 miles** to the trailhead
